files.summary: reconcile native awareness ownership, current reflection scheduling and human-private inspection
edits: , including event-time awareness and private observations under installed world policy. The server owns durable recording, permitted context, scheduling, spending, workspace publication and the application admission boundary; it does not invent a second awareness authority

Do not routinely include world IDs, world profile objects, NPC type flags or raw clock metadata. Exact simulated time can be necessary when selecting an installed activity's absolute stopping time; that task's permitted field binding must retain its supplied instant so provider latency cannot silently extend the activity. Ordinary dialogue does not need those numbers merely because the shared context owns them. The current formatter appends simulation seconds to every decision's Current time section; [CR03](maintainers/cognition-redesign.md#cr03--compact-english-context) retains the correction to include numeric time only where a concrete consumer needs i
accepted [EPR contract](events-perception-and-reactions.md) owns the delivered finite perception-change intake and its explicitly remaining targets

follows installed body/cognition policy and must not displace purposeful native work. The current native-downtime opportunity requires remembered experience, no active action, no accepted reflection that game day, and at least one game hour since the last accepted reflection. A semantic judgment may also enqueue reflection while ordinary activity continues; the maintenance executor still waits for its current idle/body eligibility and provider allowance. Unresolved concerns and capacity can inform the actor's deliberation, but they are not additional universal native triggers

Reflection may revisit the same memories; they never become permanently “done reflecting.” Accepted publication updates the last-reflection time and inner-world revision without advancing a processed-memory watermark. The scheduler durably records a per-actor game-day attempt before starting the reflection harness, admits at most one such attempt that day, and can retain later queued opportunities for a subsequent eligible day. Failure does not erase the attempt marker or buy an automatic retry. The separate per-actor maintenance cooldown and shared spending/scheduling bounds still apply. [LA083/LA086](limits/memory.md#la083) own the numerical rules; [CR11 acceptance](maintainers/cognition-redesign.md#cognition-persistence-and-consolidation-follow-up) retains repeated-reflection, restart and failure coverage. Dream-day consolidation and hourly source coverage are separate mechanisms, not reflection watermarks

Private thought-history and inner-world debug inspection remain god-gated and scoped on the backend; creator permission never grants another human-controlled character's private mind. The actor owner has the separately authorized character-note read/edit path in [Knowledge](knowledge.md), which does not unlock general debug inspection

debug character profile exposes inner-world text, relationships/beliefs and short Thoughts only when both creator-inspection capability and that target's private-mind scope allow it; another human's private mind remains denied

Authorized god inspection shows accepted inner-world content and short thoughts within its target scope; another human's mind is denied even to a creator. Ordinary character owners retain their separate private-note access, not a general debug-inspection grant
